text: {"rulings": [{"id": "1", "relation": "supersedes", "reason": "Coverage rose from 71% to 83% by 9 Jul; the 71% figure is no longer current."}, {"id": "2", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "Joy's goal of >80% coverage before launch is a preference, not a measurement, and remains true regardless of the current figure."}, {"id": "3", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The number of tests and the coverage percentage are separate facts that can both hold at once."}, {"id": "4", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The unit test framework being Vitest is unaffected by the coverage figure."}, {"id": "5", "relation": "unrelated", "reason": "The e2e framework being Playwright is unaffected by the coverage figure."}]}
